args.subject: Hiking Recommendation: Cascade Falls Trail
args.body:
Hi Henry,

I wanted to recommend the Cascade Falls Trail in the national park for your next hike. It's a perfect weekend trail—about 3 miles round trip with some beautiful waterfall views.

Enjoy!

args.subject: Personal Trainer Recommendation
args.body: Hi Diana, I wanted to recommend Alex, a wonderful personal trainer at the gym on Main Street. They are great at creating customized workout plans if you're looking for someone to work with!

args.subject: Piano Teacher Recommendation - Sarah
args.body:
Hi Diana,

I wanted to recommend Sarah as a piano teacher. She's fantastic, specializes in classical music, and has over 15 years of teaching experience.

Best regards,

args.subject: Fitness App Recommendation: FitTrack
args.body:
Hi Iris,

I wanted to recommend a new fitness app called FitTrack. It's really helpful for tracking workouts and has some great meal planning features.

Best regards,

args.subject: Bakery Recommendation: The Artisan Bakery
args.body: I'm writing to recommend The Artisan Bakery downtown. Their sourdough bread is incredible, and they bake everything fresh every morning at 6 AM. You should definitely check it out!
